select a.* FROM pa_custom_info a LEFT JOIN cust_other_info b ON a.nm = b.nm WHERE DateDiff( dd, b.etl_dt, now() ) = 1 and star >=37 AND DATE_FORMAT(birthday,'%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%m-%d' )

SELECT a.*,today.star newTarget,yesterday.star oldTarget FROM ( SELECT nm, star, etl_dt FROM cust_other_info WHERE DateDiff( dd, etl_dt, getdate ( ) ) = 1 and cast(star as int) > 30 ) today JOIN ( SELECT nm, star, etl_dt FROM cust_other_info WHERE DateDiff( dd, etl_dt, getdate ( ) ) = 2 and cast(star as int) > 30 ) yesterday ON today.nm = yesterday.nm join pa_custom_info a on a.nm = today.nm WHERE cast(today.star as int) < cast(yesterday.star as int)

SELECT a.*,today.ckzl newTarget,yesterday.ckzl oldTarget FROM ( SELECT nm, ckzl FROM cust_liability_info WHERE DateDiff( dd, etl_dt, getdate ( ) ) = 1 ) today JOIN ( SELECT nm, ckzl FROM cust_liability_info WHERE DateDiff( dd, etl_dt, getdate ( ) ) = 2 ) yesterday ON today.nm = yesterday.nm JOIN pa_custom_info a ON a.nm = today.nm WHERE today.ckzl < yesterday.ckzl and (yesterday.ckzl - today.ckzl)>500000
